title: Say it once.

scenes.title: Say it once.
scenes.vo: Hi, I'm Mira. This is Arjun's story. All day, he is fine. At night, in Mumbai, he isn't.
scenes.sub: Hi, I'm Mira. This is Arjun's story. All day, he is fine. At night, in Mumbai, he isn't.

scenes.vo: There is one thing he has not said out loud, to anyone.
scenes.sub: There is one thing he has not said out loud, to anyone.

scenes.vo: On Waypoint he gets a new name today. He types the sentence. His thumb hovers. He posts it.
scenes.sub: On Waypoint he gets a new name today. He types the sentence. His thumb hovers. He posts it.

scenes.vo: Then the Daily Path. One question, the same for everyone. He answers, and sees how others answered yesterday.
scenes.sub: Then the Daily Path. One question, the same for everyone. He answers, and sees how others answered yesterday.

scenes.vo: On the Wall, he reads what others posted tonight. Turns out it's not just him. He closes the phone, and breathes.
scenes.sub: On the Wall, he reads what others posted tonight. Turns out it's not just him. He closes the phone, and breathes.

scenes.vo: When he wants to talk, Waypoint crosses his path with one person. A short chat. Then both move on.
scenes.sub: When he wants to talk, Waypoint crosses his path with one person. A short chat. Then both move on.

scenes.vo: Waypoint. Say it once. Free on Google Play.

caption: All day he is fine. At night he isn't. Mira tells Arjun's story.
linkedin_text:
A small design note from Waypoint, told by Mira, our new guide.

Most apps ask "what's on your mind?" and get silence. Waypoint asks one specific question a day, the same for everyone, and shows how others answered yesterday. Specific beats open-ended. This short story shows the real app.
